frontmatter.title: When Charity Harms
frontmatter.statement: When does charity cause harm, through dependency, crowding out local markets or governments, or delaying reform?
frontmatter.progress: A catalog of documented harm mechanisms, with the conditions under which each appears, drawn from real cases.
frontmatter.bounty: Unfunded. The Question Bounties program will attach prizes once it is funded.

subject.body:
## Why it matters

Good intentions are not good outcomes. Some programs have made things worse, and others may have delayed the structural fixes that would have helped more. A science of giving has to study harm as carefully as help.

## Where to start

The [Failure Archive](/record/failure-archive/) collects documented cases. The work is to find the patterns that connect them.
